svg.title: Shubham Sahu, founder of NO SUS
svg.desc: Shubham Sahu, Striker No. 01 from Mumbai. Founder of NO SUS and co-founder of Aurigen. A chibi striker watches a shot fly into the top corner and the scoreboard reads NO SUS 1, LEAKS 0.

g.text: Founder of NO SUS. Co-founder of Aurigen.
I build rovers, firmware and apps that ship.
